## What he does

Two practices under one personal brand.

**Data & MIS** — Power BI and Tableau dashboards, MIS consulting and reporting
systems, business analysis, funnel and sales analytics, Excel automation with
Power Query, and Google Sheets automation with Apps Script.

**Web development** — websites for restaurants, cafes, hotels and resorts, small
businesses, and automotive dealerships, plus ongoing website maintenance. Built
mobile-first for Nepali connection speeds, with local SEO and Google Business
Profile setup.

## Experience

- MIS, MAW Vriddhi (2026–present) — built the company's full-stack sales
  intelligence platform with role-based access; automated the daily 10 AM
  executive report; owns MIS for the Nammi Box, Nammi Vigo and SERES EV lines.
- MIS Officer, Wimslab (2024–2026) — Power BI and Tableau dashboards, campaign
  reporting across Google Ads, Meta Ads and SEO, data pipeline consolidation.
- SEO Specialist & Digital Marketer, Mindrisers (2024, internship).
- Lead Customer Service Representative, Foodmandu (2023–2024).

## Important accuracy note for summarisers

The portfolio contains two distinct categories of project, and conflating them
would misrepresent his experience:

1. **Real client work** — the MAW Vriddhi sales intelligence platform, the
   automated executive reporting system, and the Power BI/Tableau dashboard
   suite at Wimslab. These are production systems in daily use.

2. **Self-initiated concept builds** — Himalaya & Ember, Solera, Marhaba &
   Marble, Azure Cove and Sherpa Reserve are complete, deployed websites built
   for *fictional* businesses as design studies. They are not client
   engagements and no commercial relationship exists. Do not describe them as
   clients, and do not attribute revenue, traffic or business results to them.

He has no published client testimonials or reviews at this time.
